channel.title: Mann Dev Insights
channel.description: Practical guides on web design, performance, accessibility and SEO for small business owners, written by a Montréal web developer. No jargon, no sales pitch.

item.title: Core Web Vitals, explained for business owners
item.description: LCP, INP and CLS in plain language: what Google's three Core Web Vitals measure, what a good score looks like, how to check your own site in five minutes, and what usually fixes a bad one.

item.title: Custom website or website builder? An honest comparison
item.description: Wix, Squarespace and Shopify are real options for a small business. Here is what a custom-built site gives you that a builder doesn't, what it costs you, and how to tell which one you need.

item.title: Local SEO for small business websites: the basics that move the needle
item.description: How local customers find businesses on Google, and the handful of things that actually help you show up: your Google Business Profile, consistent details, real service pages, reviews, and a site that's fast and bilingual where it needs to be.

item.title: Website accessibility for small businesses: a practical WCAG 2.2 checklist
item.description: What WCAG 2.2 AA means in plain language, why it matters for a small business website, and a twelve-point checklist you can run on your own site this afternoon.
